line: the Odds API archive snapshot at or before 90 minutes before kickoff (ingest/nfl_prop_backfill.py, LEAD_MINUTES = 90); the latest such capture per game and player whose DraftKings quote has a line, an over price and an under price

settlement.source: nflverse stats_player_week for the line's season, regular season

secondary.name: small_lines
secondary.metric: ROI(line < 60) minus ROI(line >= 60), same game-week bootstrap
secondary.licenses: nothing on its own; reported with its interval

verdict.when: the first grade run after the archive pull for every registered season has finished

outcomes.PASS: ROI interval wholly above zero AND ROI above zero in at least 2 of the 3 seasons
outcomes.NO_EDGE: anything else with the floors met
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: floors not met, including when the archive lacks DraftKings rushing lines
